name: Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

parts.name: Round bar C45 dia 50 mm, cold drawn

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 28 of 72 invoices paid >3 days late, max 9 days. Avg 2.8 days late; minor.

notes: Renewals settle ~2.9 pp below ask; 2026 1.4404 asked -0.6, settled -4.2 (EV-2026-70740-370010).

situation: Family bright-steel mill (EUR 98 m) supplying 20% of 1.4404 bar, all 1.4021 and 60% of C45 under a PPI-C2431 clause (share 0.8, deadband 3%). That cold-drawing index jumped 9.7% in one month (Apr->May 2026), lifting all its prices ~11% from July (1.4404 now 5.84 vs Donautal 5.45). For the coming period it proposes an AS-14404 surcharge basis for the 1.4404 bar (P18). AS-14404 rose only 5.9% Nov-25 -> Aug-26 vs PPI-C2431 +11.4%: switching is right but the base must be reset. It wants volume customers (three notes) and its owner offered an open-book calculation (twice).

pressures.evidence: Reviewing small accounts, focus on customers with volume.
Its 1.4404 price is above Donautal's; RFQ quote 6.06 even higher.

likely_tradeables.get: reset base to Donautal parity (~5.40 = 5.26 rebased on AS-14404), share <=0.45, keep 3% deadband
likely_tradeables.why: right driver for stainless; removes PPI spike

arguments_that_should_land.argument: For stainless bar the alloy surcharge drives cost: AS-14404 rose 5.9% while the cold-drawing index used in ctr:4600070740#3.2 rose 11.4%, overcharging 1.4404.
arguments_that_should_land.why: supports its own proposal but pulls price down

arguments_that_should_land.argument: AS-14404 fell 5.5% from June to September 2026.
Accept the owner's offer to walk through the calculation.

arguments_to_avoid.why: that index spiked; worse for us than AS-14404

persona.who_writes: Owner and sales director; new inside-sales contact since Oct-25
persona.relationship_notes: OTD weak (82.5% mean) but ppm low (38)

key_quotes.quote: they are reviewing small accounts and will focus on customers with volume.
